groups.why: WAITING ON THE BUILD (reference/fiddlers-gulch/brief.md): Fiddler's Gulch's lines for the rooms built after the washout, the mine and the ledge -- the tents, the grog tent, the river and upstream (51-54), their people, G1 and G3-G9 -- and the changes in Consolation (A9's third copy, G1's rod, B1's Clarion, the ride home), built in the brief's order on this branch. THE RIDE to the washout (doc 108) goes in when B3 switches over, which is when the trip is whole. A line comes off as its room is built.
